text:
olivia: quick sync on the latest compact-playground mocks. pushing a couple interaction ideas: 1) long-press / hold to stop (mobile) that keeps partial output, 2) a rewind scrubber to rollback last 2-3 tokens for quick edits, 3) prompt pin in the library for favorites. want accessibility + copy checks before dev PR.

rishi: love the pin idea. small concern: long-press semantics vary across platforms. on desktop we could map it to Alt+Click or a small caret menu "Stop options". we should avoid hidden gestures for discoverability.

olivia: agreed. propose: show both UI affordances. primary CTA: "Stop". hold/long-press reveals "Stop & Keep Partial" and "Abort (discard)". the default plain click = Stop & Keep. hover tooltip: "Stop streaming — keeps partial text for regenerate or edit"

tony: microcopy suggestion: avoid "abort" (sounds scary). maybe "Discard". also for the rewind scrubber label: "Rewind last generation". keep copy friendly and consistent.

claire: accessibility: confirm screen readers announce the scrubber as "rewind control, current position 0 of 3 tokens" and that it is reachable by keyboard. also ensure the long-press menu is accessible via keyboard (hold key like Alt or a keyboard menu key).

aria-bot: deployment note: playground/compact-controls flag toggled in staging at 2200001200. test builds 2023.4.1 include the scrubber component.

rishi: token counter behavior: current mock shows an animated increasing number during stream. NVDA users report a lot of chatter. propose debounce of 300ms + aria-live="polite". for assertive messages (like "generation stopped") use aria-live="assertive".

olivia: yes debounce 300ms works. also we should surface a tiny cost estimate under the token pill in hover: e.g., "~$0.02" but default hidden for orgs with privacy opts. add telemetry flag to A/B test cost visibility.

tony: UX trade: showing cost might reduce frivolous regens but could cause sticker shock. calibrate language: "Estimated cost: ~$0.02 (inc. context)" and link to billing FAQ.

claire: keyboard + screen reader nit: token pill needs a focusable hit target (min 44px). current mini pill is too small for touch and keyboard. bump hit area and keep visual size the same (via CSS padding). also focus ring must be visible in dark and light themes.

rishi: design token change: token-pill-bg -> use color token "surface-2" with contrast fallback #1f2428 on dark. i'll add color token variants for >=12px small text.

olivia: prompt library flow: add "pin" action in the hover card and a top-level "Pinned" filter. keyboard behavior: arrow keys navigate, Enter inserts, Space opens pin menu. ensure live region announces "Prompt pinned" when pinning.

tony: Implementation detail: when inserting a pinned prompt, we should optionally show a tiny toast: "Inserted prompt: <title> — edit before sending". keep toasts non-modal and auto-dismiss after 3s.

claire: a11y: toasts should have role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers pick them up without blocking. also make sure to support TalkBack testing on Android.

rishi: regen edge-case: if user triggers regenerate while previous stream is still being torn down, we occasionally double-charge because two generate requests overlap. need server-side idempotency key per playground session + client-side local lock when regen is triggered. filing infra ticket.

aria-bot: created ticket INF-9120: regen overlap idempotency by rishi.

olivia: dev handoff checklist for this ticket:
- UI: long-press menu + explicit menu fallback
- Rewind scrubber component with keyboard + aria labels
- Token pill: hit-area bump, debounce 300ms, aria-live per message type
- Cost estimate hover variant behind org flag + telemetry exposure
- Prompt library: pin action, keyboard nav, live announcements
- Toasts with role=status and 3s timeout
- CSS tokens: token-pill-bg variants & focus ring styles
- Server: idempotency key + regen lock e2e test

tony: assign: i'll do CSS tokens + toast patterns. rishi you take the scrubber + idempotency ticket. claire you run a quick VoiceOver/TalkBack pass on staging. olivia i'll coordinate the PR and update Figma copy.

rishi: noted, starting scrubber prototype today. will also add telemetry event \`playground.rewind\` with { positions: 1, method: 'scrubber' }

claire: will test keyboard navigation and voiceover tomorrow morning. report back in this thread.

olivia: thanks all. quick copy line for stop tooltip we agreed on: "Stop streaming — retains partial output so you can regenerate or edit." I'll update Figma and ping once frames are in the handoff board.

aria-bot: staging build 2023.4.2 deployed at 2200001400 with compact controls + scrubber.

rishi: one last thing: analytics naming convention keep as \`playground.interrupt\` for all stop-related events with method enum {"stop","discard","hold"}. keeps telemetry tidy.

tony: sounds good. tagging this P0 for UX consistency but not blocking release.

olivia: all set. will pin the landing checklist in the thread. thanks team :raised_hands:
